en.html:
...Mere liye, Muramasa only. At most, that match I could claim.

Cold steel.
Iron the colour of blood.
An insect's shape, crawling on the ground.
Na garmi, na narmi. No warmth. No softness.
A blade only.

Someone like me belonged there.
Wahin. That was the proper place.

ja.html:
……俺に似合うのはせいぜい村正だろう。

　冷たい鋼。
　血の色の鉄。
　地べたを這い回る虫の形。
　温もりも柔らかさもない、ただの刃。

　それが――俺には分相応だ。
